identificationModule.officialTitle: Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of IM96 CAR-T Cells Therapy in Patients With Advanced Digestive System Neoplasms

primaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence of Treatment Related adverse events (AEs)
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 28 days after CAR-T cell infusion

secondaryOutcomes.description: ORR, defined as the proportion of participants with a complete response or partial response, as determined by the investigator according to RECIST v1.1
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 24 weeks after CAR-T cell infusion

secondaryOutcomes.description: PFS, defined as the time from CAR-T cell infusion to the first occurrence of disease progression or death from any cause (whichever occurs first) , as determined by the investigator according to RECIST v1.1
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 24 weeks after CAR-T cell infusion

secondaryOutcomes.description: DOR, defined as the time from the first occurrence of a documented objective response to disease progression or death from any cause (whichever occurs first) in Stage 1, as determined by the investigator according to RECIST v1.1
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 24 weeks after CAR-T cell infusion

secondaryOutcomes.description: OS , defined as the time from CAR-T cell infusion to death from any cause
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 24 weeks after CAR-T cell infusion

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Persistence of CAR-T cells (cell counts and cell percentage in peripheral blood)
secondaryOutcomes.description: The persistence over time of CAR T cells in the peripheral blood as determined by flow cytometry and qPCR.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 24 weeks after CAR-T cell infusion
